pattern.name: url_parsing
pattern.description: Extracting owner and repo name from git origin remote URL
pattern.explanation: Use regex or string splitting to extract `{owner}` and `{repo}` reliably from `git config --get remote.origin.url`.

pattern.name: public_issue_template
pattern.description: Standard GitHub public issue markdown template (Excludes internal Acceptance Criteria)
pattern.code:
## Summary [Clear summary of bug or task]
## Steps to Reproduce / Context 1. [Step one] 2. [Step two]
## Expected Behavior [What should happen]
## Actual Behavior [What actually happens]

pattern.name: internal_acceptance_criteria_template
pattern.description: Private scratchpad checklist used strictly by Roo for validation (Never pushed to GitHub)

pattern.name: lazy_stakeholder_assignment_and_fallback
pattern.description: Lazy resolution and assignment workflow when issue is left open without fix
pattern.code: 1. Batch local config queries (e.g., git config --get user.email). 2. Search GitHub for account ({email}+in:email). 3. If search returns matching login -> assign that user. 4. If email is unset OR search returns 0 matches -> Unified Fallback: - Assign default repo owner (if known), OR - Prompt user via ask_followup_question: "Could not find a GitHub user for this email. Would you like to assign a specific GitHub user?"
pattern.explanation: Defer identity search until assignment is required. Apply a single consistent fallback whether email is missing or lookup finds zero results.

pattern.name: pr_merge_and_error_handling
pattern.description: Attempting PR merge directly with graceful failure handling
pattern.code: 1. Prompt user: "Merge PR now and clean up workspace" vs "Leave PR open for maintainer review". 2. If user chooses merge: - Call merge_pull_request(merge_method='squash') - If success: report success, proceed to workspace restoration and delete feature branch. - If failure: report actual error plainly, do not retry automatically, proceed to workspace restoration (git checkout main && git pull), and preserve remote branch.
pattern.explanation: Never pre-evaluate permissions. Handle any merge failure as a normal outcome and restore local workspace.
